_what_this_is: the closeout of C1 attempt 13, which never opened its run. There is no session manifest and none is fabricated: the launcher refused inside `open_run`, before `run_session` was entered, so no session record, runtime, evidence or artifact area exists to describe.
classification: PRE-PROVIDER INFRASTRUCTURE ABORT. Not an efficacy result, not a replay mismatch, and not a frozen-rule INCONCLUSIVE.

the_failure.reason: open_run rejected the externally-prepared authorization/bundle ownership contract. `_RUN_PREPARED` exempted only `grant` and `readiness_record` from the occupied-unrecorded-run rule, while `issue_c1_authorization.py --run-id` writes governance/authorization.json and `stage_c1_bundle.py --run-id` writes governance/bundle.json before the launcher runs, and `session_commit_gate` reads the authorization back from that exact path. `_RUN_GOVERNANCE` is empty, so nothing copies either in afterwards: the chain had no satisfiable ordering. Attempt 13 hit only the authorization half: its bundle record was staged without --run-id and sits at the global path, so open_run never saw a second undeclared governance file. Admitting the authorization alone would therefore have moved the same refusal to attempt 14.
the_failure.message: phase_c1/runs/attempt13 already holds 1 undeclared file(s) (['governance/authorization.json']) and has no manifest.json
the_failure.repaired_by: _RUN_PREPARED now names all four artifacts written before the run opens; see logs/budget/decisions.md 2026-09-13

budget.why_zero: open_run precedes run_session, which prices before it gates and gates before it creates. Nothing was quoted and nothing was created.

chain.why: the authorization funds exactly one launcher session and the launcher was invoked under it. A $0 pre-provider abort does not return a one-use chain. Attempt 14 needs a new grant, readiness record, authorization and bundle.

bundle_record.note: staged WITHOUT --run-id, so it landed at the global entry point rather than governance/bundle.json. That is why attempt 13 never reached the bundle half of the occupancy problem — the authorization alone was enough to refuse the run.
